receipts.summary: Authenticated embedded Duplicate Guard launch completed without a login redirect; no credential material recorded.
Observed exact owned store domain order-auditor-test-2.myshopify.com and Admin slug order-auditor-test-2.
Authenticated Admin GraphQL shop.plan.partnerDevelopment returned true.
Running immutable image tag and OCI source revision matched repo_commit exactly.
Observed production billing test mode false and billing bypass false without recording secret values.
Subscription API reported partner_development with paid features while the persisted local tier remained free and charge ID remained null.
Created exactly three pending orders: one control with distinct identity and one seed/duplicate pair with shared identity; all carry run-specific tags and receipts record only non-secret order IDs.
The run-specific duplicate order alone received Merge_Review_Candidate after orders/create processing.
Duplicate Guard review UI showed the run-specific duplicate linked to its seed with a duplicate reason and confidence.
The control fixture and baseline pre-existing order IDs retained their original tags and review state.
Upgrade returned partner_development access; recurring-charge inventory and persisted local subscription state were unchanged.

actions: Cancel each run-specific pending order when Shopify permits cancellation.
Archive all run-specific control seed and duplicate orders; retain their non-secret IDs in the cleanup receipt.
Confirm no run-specific order remains open and no pre-existing order was changed.

live_test_prerequisites: Explicit owner approval naming this run ID and allowing three pending order creations plus the Partner-development upgrade assertion.
The exact repo commit is pushed built as an immutable full-SHA image deployed and verified by OCI source revision.
Effective production SHOPIFY_BILLING_TEST_MODE and SHOPIFY_BILLING_BYPASS are both false.
Duplicate Guard is installed and authenticated on order-auditor-test-2.myshopify.com with usable write_orders access.
Admin GraphQL shop.plan.partnerDevelopment is observed true during the run.
orders/create app_subscriptions/update and shop/update webhooks are registered and the webhook worker is healthy.
Detection settings permit the shared email name and address fixture to cross the duplicate threshold.
Capture baseline IDs tags and review state for at least one pre-existing unrelated order before mutation.
Use the run ID in every fixture note email address and test tag; never reuse a prior run ID.
untested_boundaries: A Partner development store does not prove paid merchant charge approval or production recurring-charge activation.
Archive or cancellation is cleanup rather than deletion because Shopify orders generally cannot be deleted.
No live mutation is authorized or executed by this manifest.
